# Moe's Barbershop

> Moe's Barbershop is a 5.0-star men's barbershop at 99 Trafalgar Rd in Erin,
> Ontario (Canada), serving Erin, Hillsburgh and the surrounding Wellington
> County area. We specialize in classic haircuts, skin fades, beard fades and
> lineups, kids' cuts and straight-razor shaves. Appointments can be booked
> online or by phone, and walk-ins are welcome when chairs are open.

## Key facts

- **Business name:** Moe's Barbershop
- **Type:** Men's barbershop / hair salon
- **Address:** 99 Trafalgar Rd, Erin, Ontario, N0B 1Z0, Canada
- **Phone:** (519) 855-4455
- **Email:** moesbarber99@gmail.com
- **Website:** https://www.moesbarbershop.ca
- **Online booking:** https://moes-barbershop.square.site/
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/moes_barbershopp/
- **Rating:** 5.0 out of 5 (103+ Google reviews)
- **Price range:** $$ (CAD$10–$100 per service)
- **Payment accepted:** Cash, credit card, debit card

## Hours

- Monday: 9:30 a.m. – 7:00 p.m.
- Tuesday: 9:30 a.m. – 7:00 p.m.
- Wednesday: 9:30 a.m. – 7:00 p.m.

- Friday: 9:30 a.m. – 7:00 p.m.

- Sunday: 9:30 a.m. – 5:00 p.m.

## Services and prices (CAD)

- Moe's Haircut — $100, 1 hr (signature service with consultation and precision cut)
- Haircut & Beard — $50, 30 mins
- Classic Haircut — $30, 20 mins
- Beard Fade & Lineup — $30, 20 mins
- Senior Haircut — $25, 25 mins
- Kids Haircut — $25, 20 mins
- Kids Haircut + Design — $30, 30 mins
- Threading — $10, 5 mins
- Wax — $15, 15 mins

## Areas served

Erin, Hillsburgh, Caledon, Orangeville, Georgetown, Acton, Guelph, Rockwood,
Fergus, Elora, Halton Hills, and the wider Wellington County region of Ontario,
Canada.
